capabilities: Look up Chinese words in a popover with Pinyin, Jyutping, simplified/traditional Hanzi, and definitions
Segment Chinese text into whole words on double-click using CC-CEDICT and Intl.Segmenter
Play neural pronunciation audio for Mandarin and Cantonese with adjustable speed
Star words to save them permanently into a Markdown vocabulary note
Review saved words in a sidebar with search, filters, and flashcard quiz mode
extras: On first run the plugin downloads a ~42 MB offline CC-CEDICT dictionary from GitHub Releases; audio defaults to Google TTS online but can be switched to offline Web Speech API. Dictionary data is licensed CC-BY-SA 3.0.
motivation: Reading and studying Chinese in Obsidian pulls the reader out of their flow; the author wanted a desktop-grade popover lookup inside the app.
problem: Obsidian has no Chinese word boundaries, so double-clicking selects a single character or whole paragraph, and there is no built-in dictionary lookup for Chinese learners.

relations.evidence: Powered by CC-CEDICT merged with Pleco's Cantonese readings, CC-Canto, and Rime Cantonese.
Pleco Software: Hand-curated Cantonese readings database.
Rime Cantonese: Frequency and phonetic mappings.

summary: Chinese popover dictionary that shows Pinyin, Jyutping, definitions, and audio on word lookup, with word segmentation and a saved vocabulary notebook.
